// Negative fixture for surface/src/timing-lint.ts (read by surface/test/timing-lint.test.ts, never run): nothing here
// depends on the machine's speed, and the check must find nothing. Each block names the near miss it guards.
import { expect, setDefaultTimeout, setSystemTime, test } from "bun:test";

// Generous timeouts are hang guards, not races; 0 disables the timeout.
setDefaultTimeout(60_000);
test("a generous timeout", async () => {
	await work();
}, 60_000);
test("no timeout", async () => {
	await work();
}, 0);
test("a generous timeout object", () => {}, { timeout: 30_000 });
test("two arguments only", () => {});

// Timing words inside strings, templates, regexes and comments are not code: Bun.sleep(5), setTimeout(r, 5).
test("strings are data", () => {
	const script = "await Bun.sleep(50); setTimeout(() => {}, 10);";
	const tpl = `while (Date.now() < end) { await Bun.sleep(25) }`;
	const nested = `${label}: setTimeout(cb, 5) ${render(`Date.now() - t0`)}`;
	const re = /Bun\.sleep\(|setTimeout\(/;
	/* Promise.race([a, timeout]) */
	expect(gate.refuses("sleep 60")).toBe(true);
});

// A method on another object is not the global timer, and a declaration is not a call.
type Host = { isIdle(): boolean; setTimeout(callback: () => void, ms: number): unknown };
const host = { setTimeout(cb: () => void, ms: number): number { return 0; } };
interface Clock {
	setTimeout(callback: () => void, ms: number): number;
	setInterval(callback: () => void, ms: number): number
}
class FakeClock {
	private queue: unknown[] = [];
	setTimeout(callback: () => void, ms: number): number {
		return 0;
	}
	public setInterval(callback: () => void, ms: number): number {
		return 0;
	}
}
function setTimeout(callback: () => void, ms: number): number {
	return 0;
}
test("injected timers", () => {
	ctx.setTimeout(() => api.send("a"), 1);
	clock.setTimeout(fire, 5_000);
	timers.sleep(10);
});

// A failure-only process watchdog: a SIGKILL at least the default test timeout away, bound to a name and cleared in the
// same test once the real event arrives. It fires only on a hang, so the machine's speed cannot change a passing result.
test("a cleared watchdog", async () => {
	const p = Bun.spawn(["omp", "--mode", "rpc"]);
	const timer = setTimeout(() => p.kill("SIGKILL"), 30_000);
	const guard = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
		p.kill("SIGKILL");
	}, 60_000);
	try {
		for await (const chunk of p.stdout) if (seen(chunk)) break;
	} finally {
		clearTimeout(timer);
		clearTimeout(guard);
		p.kill("SIGKILL");
	}
	expect(result).toMatchObject({ status: "error" });
});

// Fixture timestamps: the wall clock plus or minus a duration places data hours away and measures nothing.
test("fixture timestamps", () => {
	const eightDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 8 * 86_400_000).toISOString();
	const later = new Date(Date.now() + 120_000);
	const stale = Date.now() - HOUR_MS;
	const t = new Date(Date.now() - days * DAY_MS);
	const shifted = new Date(Date.now() - offset).toISOString();
	const lease = Date.now() + LEASE_MS + 1000;
	expect(until).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.now() + LEASE_MS + 1000);
	expect(newestChange(dir, Date.now() - HOUR_MS)).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now() - 9 * HOUR_MS);
	const id = makeRunId(Date.now(), "x");
	expect(row.at).toEqual(Date.now());
	const backdateMs = 5 * 60_000;
	const backdated = new Date(Date.now() - backdateMs);
	expect(
		lease,
	).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now() - backdateMs);
});

// A race of two real events is not a deadline race.
test("racing two exits", async () => {
	const first = await Promise.race([a.exited.then(() => a), b.exited.then(() => b)]);
	expect(first).toBeDefined();
});

// A fake clock is not the wall clock.
test("fake clock", () => {
	setSystemTime(new Date(T0 + 5 * MIN));
	expect(isStale(row)).toBe(true);
});

// Names that merely contain a timing word are not calls to it.
test("lookalikes", () => {
	const asleep = mySleep(5);
	const waitForReady = waiting(3);
	expect(sleepCount).toBe(0);
});

// Prose about the marker is not an opt-out: the timing-under-test marker is only needed for timing tests.
test("prose", () => {
	expect(1).toBe(1); // a trailing note may mention timing-under-test too
});
